title: Loads to the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account
content:
**Loads post as their originators send them.** The Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account receives four kinds of load:

- employer payroll and off-cycle loads, funded through the employer's Payroll Card Program;
- early wage transfers from the cardholder's Paystride Access plan;
- instant pay disbursements from an employer's Instant Pay service;
- withdrawals from the cardholder's own Paystride Save account.

Each load carries its originating record and the originator's name.

## Conditions

| Rule | Effect |
|---|---|
| A load posts only to an account whose status is issued, active or blocked | a load to a closed account is returned to its originator in full and never posts |
| An originating record posts as a load to a given account once | a second posting of the same record does not occur |
| A load that would take the balance above the plan's largest balance | is returned to its originator in full and never posts |
| A blocked card stops spending, never wages | loads post to a blocked account |

## Fees on receipt

Receiving an early wage transfer costs the plan's early wage transfer load fee. Receiving an instant pay disbursement costs the plan's instant pay load fee. Where the fee is zero, no fee is assessed.

## First deposit date

The first load ever posted to the account sets the first deposit date to its posted date, which starts the new-account period. Later loads never change it.

*Hypothetical case:* an account on a plan whose largest balance is 12500 holds 12320.00. A payroll load of 240.00 would take it to 12560.00, so the whole load is returned to the employer's program. A load of 150.00 posts.
